newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Kredietbank wins China banking licence.
newsitem.headline: Kredietbank wins China banking licence.

text.p: Belgian Kredietbank NV (KB) said on Monday its Shanghai representative office had been given a full banking licence, making Kredietbank the first Belgian financial institution to be granted such a licence in China.
The licence was handed to KB managing director Remi Vermeiren by the governor of the People's Bank of China, Dai Xianglong, on Monday.
The new branch, to be headed by John Hollows, 40, will start operations in April or May 1997 and is the fifth Kredietbank branch in Asia, which the bank considers an important area.
KB has representative offices in Jakarta, Bangkok and Bombay, and branches in Shanghai, Hong Kong, Singapore, Taipei and Manila.

The Shanghai branch will finance Chino-Belgian trade and trade between China and the rest of the world, carry out payments between the countries, and focus on short-term lending to large, local companies and joint ventures.
